concepts.label: Read and write numbers from the millions to the thousandths in standard form, word form and expanded form.
Explain the value of a digit from its place, using the ten-times relationship between neighbouring places from the thousandths to the millions.
Compare and order whole numbers and decimals to the thousandths by comparing place values from the left.
